expected_issues.title: Disposable returned by _renderWorkspacePicker() is discarded
expected_issues.description:
render() discards the IDisposable returned by _renderWorkspacePicker(), so the workspace-selection event subscription is never disposed and leaks with every widget.

_renderWorkspacePicker() returns the onDidSelectWorkspace subscription. Ignoring the return value leaves the listener attached after the widget is disposed (VS Code's leak detector reports it), and a disposed widget may keep reacting to selection events. The result must be registered on the widget (this._register(...)).
